conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful silicone/cationic system (Dimethiconol @11, Dimethicone @14, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @13) plus a pearlizer (Glycol Distearate @9) and late humectants (Glycerin @23, Panthenol @25). C2 is not met because no silicone is early: Parfum sits at @6, so Dimethiconol @11 is after the E3 point (C2 'early' = prominent). Counter-signal: every other C2 element is present and the early Parfum position makes the silicone less trace than its post-E3 position suggests, so high is the neighbor.
